$comment: Editorial batch 2026l (CONT-17): trivia pairs for five high-search topics with zero catalogue coverage — The Simpsons, Game of Thrones, Studio Ghibli, Sonic the Hedgehog and Christmas. Every answer is a stable, checkable fact; no seasons in progress, spin-offs, box office or news about people. Emitted by scripts/seed/emit-editorial-seed.mjs.

quizzes.title: The Simpsons Fan Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Springfield's yellow family has been on the air since 1989. From D'oh! to Duff, how much do you remember from The Simpsons?

questions.question: In which town do the Simpsons live?
questions.explanation: Springfield, next door to its eternal rival Shelbyville; Ogdenville and Brockway appear in the episode 'Marge vs. the Monorail'.

questions.question: Where does Homer work?

options.text: At the Springfield Nuclear Power Plant

questions.explanation: Homer is the safety inspector of sector 7-G at Mr. Burns's nuclear plant.

questions.question: In which year did The Simpsons premiere as a half-hour series?
questions.explanation: The first episode aired on 17 December 1989; the family had debuted two years earlier in shorts on The Tracey Ullman Show.

questions.question: What is the name of the family's dog?
questions.explanation: They adopt him at the dog track in the very first episode; Snowball II is the cat and Itchy is the cartoon mouse.

questions.question: Which instrument does Lisa play?
questions.explanation: Lisa's baritone sax solo is part of the opening credits of every episode.

questions.question: Who runs the Kwik-E-Mart?
questions.explanation: Apu Nahasapeemapetilon works endless shifts at the Kwik-E-Mart; Moe owns the tavern.

questions.question: Who is Bart's best friend?
questions.explanation: Milhouse is Bart's loyal — and hopelessly uncool — sidekick; Nelson is the school bully.

questions.question: What does Homer shout when something goes wrong?
questions.explanation: 'D'oh!' is so famous it entered the Oxford English Dictionary; 'Ay, caramba!' is Bart's line.

quizzes.title: Trivia fan de Los Simpson: Springfield
quizzes.description: La familia amarilla de Springfield está al aire desde 1989. Del Duff al '¡Ay, caramba!', ¿cuánto recuerdas de Los Simpson?

questions.question: ¿En qué ciudad vive la familia Simpson?
questions.explanation: Springfield, junto a su eterna rival Shelbyville; Ogdenville y Capital City son otras ciudades de la serie.

questions.question: ¿Dónde trabaja Homer?

options.text: En la planta nuclear de Springfield

questions.explanation: Homer es inspector de seguridad del sector 7-G en la planta nuclear del señor Burns.

questions.question: ¿En qué año se estrenó la serie con episodios propios?
questions.explanation: El primer episodio se emitió el 17 de diciembre de 1989; en 1987 la familia había debutado en cortos dentro del show de Tracey Ullman.

questions.question: ¿Qué cerveza toma siempre Homer?
questions.explanation: La Duff es la cerveza de Springfield; la Fudd es su parodia de Shelbyville y Pawtucket es de Padre de familia.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama el vecino devoto y amable de los Simpson?
questions.explanation: Ned Flanders, con su 'Okely-dokely', vive al lado y aguanta a Homer con una paciencia infinita.

questions.question: ¿Qué instrumento toca Lisa?
questions.explanation: El solo de saxofón de Lisa en los créditos iniciales cambia en cada episodio.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es la frase clásica de Bart?
questions.explanation: '¡Ay, caramba!' es el grito de Bart; '¡D'oh!' es de Homer, '¡Excelente!' del señor Burns y '¡Okely-dokely!' de Flanders.

quizzes.title: Game of Thrones Fan Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Eight seasons of houses, dragons and betrayals across Westeros. Test what you remember from Game of Thrones and its world.

questions.question: On which book series is Game of Thrones based?

options.text: A Song of Ice and Fire

questions.explanation: George R.R. Martin's A Song of Ice and Fire began with A Game of Thrones in 1996.

questions.question: What is the motto of House Stark?
questions.explanation: 'Winter Is Coming' belongs to the Starks; 'Fire and Blood' is Targaryen, 'Hear Me Roar' Lannister and 'We Do Not Sow' Greyjoy.

questions.question: What are the names of Daenerys's three dragons?
questions.explanation: She named them after her husband Drogo and her brothers Rhaegar and Viserys; Balerion, Meraxes and Vhagar are dragons of earlier Targaryens.

questions.question: What is the name of Jon Snow's direwolf?
questions.explanation: Ghost is Jon's albino direwolf; Nymeria is Arya's, Grey Wind Robb's and Summer Bran's.

questions.question: Which of these materials can kill a White Walker?
questions.explanation: Only Valyrian steel and dragonglass can destroy a White Walker — normal weapons shatter against them.

questions.question: What is the name of Arya Stark's sword?
questions.explanation: Jon gives Arya the slender blade she names Needle; Longclaw is Jon's own sword and Ice is Ned Stark's.

questions.question: In which years did the HBO series air?
questions.explanation: Eight seasons, from April 2011 to May 2019.

questions.question: Who is known as 'the Mother of Dragons'?
questions.explanation: Daenerys earned the title when she hatched three dragons in Khal Drogo's funeral pyre.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Juego de Tronos para fans
quizzes.description: Ocho temporadas de casas, dragones y traiciones por todo Poniente. Pon a prueba cuánto recuerdas de Juego de Tronos.

questions.question: ¿En qué serie de novelas se basa Juego de Tronos?
questions.explanation: Canción de hielo y fuego, de George R.R. Martin, comenzó con la novela Juego de tronos en 1996.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el lema de la casa Stark?
questions.explanation: 'Se acerca el invierno' es de los Stark; 'Fuego y sangre' es Targaryen, 'Oye mi rugido' Lannister y 'Nosotros no sembramos' Greyjoy.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llaman los tres dragones de Daenerys?
questions.explanation: Los nombró por su esposo Drogo y sus hermanos Rhaegar y Viserys; Balerion, Meraxes y Vhagar son dragones de Targaryen anteriores.

questions.question: ¿Cuál es el nombre del lobo huargo de Jon Snow?
questions.explanation: Fantasma es el huargo albino de Jon; Nymeria es de Arya, Viento Gris de Robb y Verano de Bran.

questions.question: ¿Qué material puede destruir a un Caminante Blanco?
questions.explanation: Solo el acero valyrio y el vidriagón los destruyen; las armas normales se rompen contra ellos.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama la espada de Arya Stark?
questions.explanation: Jon regala a Arya la fina espada que ella bautiza Aguja; Larga Garra es la espada de Jon y Hielo la de Ned Stark.

questions.question: ¿Quién es conocida como 'la Madre de Dragones'?
questions.explanation: Daenerys ganó el título al eclosionar tres dragones en la pira funeraria de Khal Drogo.

quizzes.title: Studio Ghibli Fan Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: From Totoro to Spirited Away, Studio Ghibli built some of animation's most beloved worlds. How well do you know them?

questions.question: In which year was Studio Ghibli founded?
questions.explanation: Hayao Miyazaki, Isao Takahata and Toshio Suzuki founded the studio in 1985, after Nausicaä's success.

questions.question: Which Ghibli film won the Oscar for Best Animated Feature in 2003?
questions.explanation: Spirited Away (2001) took the statuette at the March 2003 ceremony; Howl's was nominated two years later but lost.

questions.question: Which character is Studio Ghibli's mascot, featured in its logo?
questions.explanation: The giant forest spirit Totoro appears in the studio's logo before every film.

questions.question: In Spirited Away, where does Chihiro work to save her parents?
questions.explanation: The witch Yubaba forces her to work in the bathhouse where gods and spirits come to relax.

questions.question: What is the name of the fire demon who powers Howl's moving castle?
questions.explanation: Calcifer is the little flame bound to Howl's heart that keeps the castle walking.

questions.question: Who directed My Neighbor Totoro and Spirited Away?
questions.explanation: Both are Hayao Miyazaki films; Takahata directed Grave of the Fireflies and Yonebayashi Arrietty.

questions.question: Which Miyazaki film follows a goldfish girl who wants to become human?
questions.explanation: Ponyo (2008) loosely retells The Little Mermaid through the friendship between Ponyo and Sosuke.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Studio Ghibli para fans
quizzes.description: De Totoro a El viaje de Chihiro, Studio Ghibli creó algunos de los mundos más queridos de la animación. ¿Cuánto los conoces?

questions.question: ¿En qué año se fundó Studio Ghibli?
questions.explanation: Hayao Miyazaki, Isao Takahata y Toshio Suzuki fundaron el estudio en 1985, tras el éxito de Nausicaä.

questions.question: ¿Qué película de Ghibli ganó el Óscar a mejor película animada en 2003?
questions.explanation: El viaje de Chihiro (2001) recibió la estatuilla en la ceremonia de marzo de 2003.

questions.question: ¿Qué personaje es la mascota oficial del estudio y aparece en su logotipo?
questions.explanation: El gran espíritu del bosque Totoro abre el logotipo del estudio antes de cada película.

questions.question: En El viaje de Chihiro, ¿dónde trabaja Chihiro para salvar a sus padres?

options.text: En una casa de baños de los espíritus

questions.explanation: La bruja Yubaba la obliga a trabajar en la casa de baños donde los dioses y espíritus van a descansar.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama el demonio de fuego que mueve el castillo de Howl?
questions.explanation: Calcifer es la llamita ligada al corazón de Howl que mantiene el castillo en movimiento; Sin Cara es el espíritu de El viaje de Chihiro.

questions.question: ¿Quién dirigió Mi vecino Totoro y El viaje de Chihiro?
questions.explanation: Ambas son de Hayao Miyazaki; Takahata dirigió La tumba de las luciérnagas y Yonebayashi Arrietty.

questions.question: ¿Qué película de Isao Takahata es un drama sobre dos hermanos en la Segunda Guerra Mundial?

options.text: El cuento de la princesa Kaguya

questions.explanation: La tumba de las luciérnagas (1988), de Takahata, sigue a Seita y Setsuko en el Japón de 1945.

quizzes.title: Sonic the Hedgehog Fan Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: The blue blur has been speeding through Green Hill Zone since 1991. Test how well you know Sonic the Hedgehog.

questions.question: In which year was the first Sonic the Hedgehog game released?
questions.explanation: Sonic the Hedgehog launched on 23 June 1991 and turned the blue hedgehog into Sega's mascot.

questions.question: On which console did Sonic make his debut?
questions.explanation: He debuted on Sega's 16-bit console — Genesis in North America, Mega Drive elsewhere.

questions.question: What does Sonic drop when he takes a hit?
questions.explanation: As long as Sonic holds at least one ring, a hit only scatters them instead of costing a life.

questions.question: Who is Sonic's two-tailed fox sidekick?
questions.explanation: Miles 'Tails' Prower joined in Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992) and can fly by spinning his two tails.

questions.question: What does Knuckles guard on Angel Island?
questions.explanation: Knuckles, the red echidna from Sonic 3 (1994), is the last guardian of the Master Emerald.

questions.question: How many Chaos Emeralds does Sonic need to turn into Super Sonic?
questions.explanation: All seven Chaos Emeralds turn Sonic golden and nearly invincible — a transformation introduced in Sonic 2.

questions.question: What is the name of Sonic's arch-enemy?

options.text: Dr. Robotnik, also known as Dr. Eggman

questions.explanation: The mustached scientist is called Robotnik in the West and Eggman in Japan; the others are villains from Mega Man, Mario and Donkey Kong.

quizzes.title: Trivia fan de Sonic the Hedgehog
quizzes.description: El erizo azul corre por Green Hill Zone desde 1991. Pon a prueba cuánto sabes de Sonic the Hedgehog y su mundo.

questions.question: ¿En qué año se lanzó el primer juego de Sonic the Hedgehog?
questions.explanation: Sonic the Hedgehog salió el 23 de junio de 1991 y convirtió al erizo azul en la mascota de Sega.

questions.question: ¿En qué consola debutó Sonic?
questions.explanation: Debutó en la consola de 16 bits de Sega, llamada Genesis en América y Mega Drive en el resto del mundo.

questions.question: ¿Qué suelta Sonic cuando recibe un golpe?
questions.explanation: Mientras Sonic conserve al menos un anillo, un golpe solo los dispersa en lugar de costarle una vida.

questions.question: ¿Quién es el compañero zorro de dos colas de Sonic?
questions.explanation: Miles 'Tails' Prower se unió en Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (1992) y puede volar girando sus dos colas.

questions.question: ¿Qué vigila Knuckles en la Isla Ángel?
questions.explanation: Knuckles, la equidna roja que debutó en Sonic 3 (1994), es el último guardián de la Esmeralda Maestra.

questions.question: ¿Cuántas esmeraldas del Caos necesita Sonic para convertirse en Super Sonic?
questions.explanation: Las siete esmeraldas vuelven a Sonic dorado y casi invencible; la transformación apareció en Sonic 2.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama el enemigo principal de Sonic?

options.text: Dr. Robotnik, también llamado Dr. Eggman

questions.explanation: El científico del bigote es Robotnik en Occidente y Eggman en Japón; los otros son villanos de Mega Man, Mario y Donkey Kong.

quizzes.title: Christmas Fan Trivia Challenge
quizzes.description: Carols, classic films and traditions from Christmas trees to Rudolph: test how much you know about Christmas around the world.

questions.question: In Home Alone (1990), what is the name of the boy left behind?
questions.explanation: Kevin, played by Macaulay Culkin, is left behind when the family flies to Paris; Buzz and Jeff are his brothers and Fuller his cousin.

questions.question: Who wrote 'A Christmas Carol', the story of Ebenezer Scrooge?
questions.explanation: Dickens published the novella in 1843; its ghosts of Christmas Past, Present and Yet to Come visit Scrooge on Christmas Eve.

questions.question: In which year was Elf, starring Will Ferrell as Buddy, released?
questions.explanation: Buddy travels from the North Pole to New York in the 2003 film directed by Jon Favreau.

questions.question: 'Jingle Bells' was originally written for which holiday?
questions.explanation: James Lord Pierpont published it in 1857 as 'One Horse Open Sleigh', meant for Thanksgiving; Christmas adopted it later.

questions.question: Which reindeer earns a place at the front of Santa's sleigh thanks to his glowing red nose?
questions.explanation: Rudolph was created in 1939 for a Montgomery Ward booklet; the other three come from the 1823 poem 'The Night Before Christmas'.

questions.question: In 'It's a Wonderful Life' (1946), what happens every time a bell rings?
questions.explanation: The line is Zuzu's: her father's guardian angel Clarence earns his wings by the end of the film.

questions.question: Which country is credited with starting the decorated Christmas tree tradition?
questions.explanation: The modern Tannenbaum spread from Germany in the 16th century, long before it reached the rest of the world.

quizzes.title: Trivia de Navidad: tradiciones y clásicos
quizzes.description: Villancicos, películas clásicas y tradiciones de la Navidad, del árbol a los Reyes Magos. ¿Cuánto sabes de estas fiestas?

questions.question: ¿Qué niño queda solo en casa en la película navideña de 1990?
questions.explanation: Kevin, interpretado por Macaulay Culkin, se queda atrás cuando la familia vuela a París; Buzz y Jeff son sus hermanos y Fuller su primo.

questions.question: ¿Quién escribió 'Cuento de Navidad', la historia del señor Scrooge?
questions.explanation: Dickens publicó la novela en 1843; los espíritus de las Navidades pasadas, presentes y futuras visitan a Scrooge en Nochebuena.

questions.question: ¿Cómo se llama el reno de la nariz roja?
questions.explanation: Rodolfo (Rudolph) nació en un folleto de 1939; los otros renos vienen del poema de 1823 'La noche antes de Navidad'.

questions.question: ¿En qué año se estrenó Elf, la película de Will Ferrell?
questions.explanation: Buddy viaja del Polo Norte a Nueva York en la película de 2003 dirigida por Jon Favreau.

questions.question: ¿Qué personaje verde odia la Navidad en el clásico del Dr. Seuss?
questions.explanation: El Grinch robó la Navidad en el libro de 1957; Jack Skellington solo quiso celebrarla a su manera y Scrooge es de Dickens.

questions.question: Según la tradición, ¿qué regalos llevaron los Reyes Magos al niño Jesús?
questions.explanation: Melchor, Gaspar y Baltasar ofrecieron oro, incienso y mirra, que se recuerdan el 6 de enero.

questions.question: ¿De qué país viene la tradición del árbol de Navidad decorado?
questions.explanation: El Tannenbaum moderno se extendió desde Alemania en el siglo XVI, mucho antes de llegar al resto del mundo.
